svg.title: Secure URL shortener AWS target topology
svg.desc: Non-applied AWS target: optional Route 53 reaches a WAF-protected public Application Load Balancer with an ACM certificate, then private ECS Fargate tasks across two Availability Zones. ECS uses Secrets Manager and an immutable ECR image, connects to isolated Aurora PostgreSQL, and sends observability data to CloudWatch. VPC endpoints, S3 gateway access, VPC DNS, KMS, and optional NAT support the private network.
